summary: Confirmed all 12 estimates against the saved 54-page PDF and the current extraction specification and codebook. Read the entire 119358-character markdown conversion in contiguous chunks, including references and Appendices A-C. Extracted every PDF page cited by the estimate sources with PyMuPDF. All 71 populated numerical fields and p-value bounds in stats and analysis counts match the correct outcome and arm columns: Table 1 (PDF p. 14, printed p. 11) supplies arm means, participant SDs and arm counts; Table 2 (PDF p. 16, printed p. 13) explicitly supplies the 148 No-AI and 212 AI counts; Table 5 (PDF p. 23, printed p. 20) supplies the three full-sample AI coefficients, robust SEs, significance markings and 360-person analysis counts. Unprinted pair totals, pooled means and SDs, and contrast uncertainty are correctly left null. The four reported measure=length flags are validator false positives. Section 6 of creativity-codebook.md explicitly defines length as "Word or character count of the output", and extraction-spec.md also includes length in the allowed measure vocabulary. Table 1 defines Number of characters as text length measured in characters. All four s1_characters estimates therefore correctly use construct=elaboration, measure=length and higher_is=other, explained as more characters. No recoding is warranted. Confirmed question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, outcome_timing, within_person, comparison_type and se_basis for every estimate. Creativity is the mean of four ratings of one composition per participant (PDF p. 9); the extraction explicitly preserves the conflicting scale minima in the main text and instructions (PDF pp. 9, 32, 34). DAT follows the experimental stages (PDF p. 8), after ChatGPT access ends (PDF p. 31), supporting immediate after_ai, outcome_with_ai=false and within-person associative flexibility. All contrasts are between subjects. The regressions use one observation per participant with robust SEs; the descriptive comparisons print no contrast uncertainty. The unspecified individual-versus-session assignment protocol is already documented as unresolved. No additional in-scope outcome or contrast was found in the saved paper and bound appendices. Each of the three eligible outcomes has the pooled AI-access regression and the three same-incentive arm comparisons. Table 2 adjusts for post-treatment variables; the mediation and AI-use analyses are correctly excluded. Similarity compares each writer with that writer’s own AI responses (PDF p. 36), not different people. Incentive differences do not vary the AI configuration. Completeness conclusions are limited to the supplied paper and bound appendices.
